class Held:
    def __init__(self, name, hp):
        self.name = name
        self.hp   = hp

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return self.hp == other.hp

a = Held('Aldric', 100)
b = Held('Lyria', 100)
c = Held('Thorn', 80)

print(a == b)
print(a == c)
print(a is b)
